# /crav1-build-tasks

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [Build tasks](../../from-plan-to-build.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-build-tasks/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Build tasks from tasks.md, always in an isolated worker per task; asks which tasks (one, a range, or all).

**[`/crav1-build-tasks`](crav1-build-tasks.md)** opens with one question: which tasks to build, one `T#`, a range, or all unticked, listing the ready ones with the [`/crav1-tasks-ready-to-build`](crav1-tasks-ready-to-build.md) rules. It skips the question when the message names the tasks. Every task runs in its own worker (implement, commit, verify, optional fix), and every path ends by naming [`/crav1-open-pr`](crav1-open-pr.md). It replaces implement-task, complete-task, and complete-tasks; their rules are kept as branches.

Inside each worker (was `/crav1-implement-task`): One `tasks.md` row, then run its verify step.

Inside each worker (was `/crav1-implement-task`): Before the tests, checks the local dependencies they need (Azurite, a database container, an emulator) and asks start, skip, or stop for one that is not running. Tests skipped for a missing dependency do not tick the row unless you chose skip.

One task (was `/crav1-complete-task`): Isolated worker for one `T#`: implement → commit → verify → optional fix; persist commit style as a rule.

One task (was `/crav1-complete-task`): When a local test dependency is not running, the worker returns `needs_dependency` with a `BLOCKER:` line, and you answer start, skip, or stop.

A range or all (was `/crav1-complete-tasks`): Orchestrates one worker per `T#` (`T1-T3` or all unchecked); stops the batch when a worker needs you.

1.64.0: a task's `(branch: …)` is offered first (Recommended) in the Build prompt; range and all-tasks runs switch to each task's branch on a clean tree, and a missing branch blocks that task.

1.68.0: offers to create a missing task sub-branch from its spec branch and writes its `(into …)` marker after the yes.

## Choice words

Exact words for bots and scripted runs (no `--flags`). A word in the invocation takes that choice without asking. A headless or bot run with no word stops and names the valid words.

| Question | Word | Means |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Which tasks | `one task` | one task (add `T#`, or the first unticked) |
| Which tasks | `range` | a range (add `T#-T#`) |
| Which tasks | `all tasks` | all unticked tasks |

## Runs when

You want to build one task, a range, or all unticked tasks. Called by the user and by `crav1-build-task-agent`.

## Reads

In short: Inside each worker: One `T#`, the plan, and the spec; One task: One `T#` and the persist rule; A range or all: The `T#` queue on one spec.

Inside each worker: Reads one `T#` in `tasks.md`, plus `plan.md` and `spec.md`. One task: Reads one `T#` and the persist rule. A range or all: Reads the `T#` queue on one spec.

## Writes

In short: Inside each worker: The code and checks that `T#` names, and `[x]` on that row when its verify passes; One task: The commit-style rule when it is missing; its worker writes that task's code, `tasks.md`, `verify.md`, `fix-log.md` when a fix runs, and the commits; A range or all: The commit-style rule once, when missing; one worker per `T#` writes that task's code, `tasks.md`, `verify.md`, `fix-log.md` when a fix runs, and the commits.

Inside each worker: Writes the code and the checks that row names, and marks the row `[x]` only when that verify passes. One task: Writes the commit-style rule when it is missing. A range or all: Writes the commit-style rule once when it is missing.

## Does not

Inside each worker: Leaves `spec.md` and other tasks alone. One task: Leaves product code, `spec.md`, push, and the pull request alone in this chat. A range or all: Leaves product code, commits, `spec.md`, push, and the pull request alone in this chat.

Limits and exceptions: Inside each worker: stops with no code when `## Linter` says none and the user has not chosen to go on. It does not ask to run [`/crav1-refresh-system-notes`](crav1-refresh-system-notes.md). One task: it does not ask to run [`/crav1-refresh-system-notes`](crav1-refresh-system-notes.md).

## You run next / Runs by itself

- You run next: [`/crav1-open-pr`](crav1-open-pr.md); [`/crav1-verify-build-against-spec`](crav1-verify-build-against-spec.md)
- Runs by itself: Inside each worker: Calls [`/crav1-create-feature-branch`](crav1-create-feature-branch.md) before code. One task: Calls [`/crav1-create-feature-branch`](crav1-create-feature-branch.md) and `crav1-build-task-agent`. A range or all: Calls [`/crav1-create-feature-branch`](crav1-create-feature-branch.md) and `crav1-build-task-agent` once per `T#`.
